title: Graph embedding identifies LC-61 with anti-Leishmania activity
summary: A multiscale graph embedding workflow prioritized LC-61, which the study experimentally evaluated against L. infantum. The finding is a specific in-vitro compound result; it does not establish clinical efficacy, safety or a validated target.
ai_technology: Multiscale-aware graph embedding and machine learning

evidence.tested: Primary article/PubMed and institutional manuscript identify LC-61 and its experimental parasite assay.
evidence.unknown: Exact prior structures and broader dose/replication details remain open.
evidence.ai_role: Graph embedding ranks candidate molecules for assay; human selection and experimental testing follow.

source_review.scope: author-institution primary full-text PDF; PubMed primary metadata. Material checked for the specific claims stated in the record.
